scope: Accept supplied sparse sampled feedback for fleet/coast, not continuous smoothness, natural material parity, touch response or phone FPS.

hitFlash.evidence: White silhouette at.1/.2 and normal by.4 in both scenarios/profiles; hull35→27 and return prompt visible.

impactRecognition.evidence: Small orange hit at.1/.2 distinct from large irregular fireball at1; sparks/smoke at1.5, no fire2/3.

smokeFading.evidence: Curved trails retain turn path and older portions thin; coast smoke cloud dissipates after1.5.
smokeFading.weakness: Granular gray smoke competes with water texture; exact transitions unverified.

wakeContinuity.evidence: Fleet stern wakes stay attached through ship translation.
wakeContinuity.weakness: Repeated puffs lack natural tapered foam.

cameraMotion.evidence: Player stays central after fleet catch-up and throughout coastal turn. Runway, trees and shoreline maintain coherent positions.

controlVisibility.evidence: HUD/buttons/ring remain legible; heat changes visible; plane trackable over terrain, runway and ocean.
controlVisibility.weakness: Fallback ring jagged; deck overlap unresolved; fleet ship crosses under Bomb at3 seconds and coast wingman label approaches mission text. Touch untested.

shorelineContinuity.evidence: Foam strokes remain aligned with shoreline through scroll, widening/softening across supplied samples without observed detached jumps.
shorelineContinuity.weakness: Long pale streaks form an offshore ribbon; natural wave breakup and beach contact are still unconvincing, especially bright segments at0.4–1.5.

regressionsAndLimits: No new sampled feedback failure observed.
Recent foam has less dotted appearance but still looks like a drawn offshore strip.
Motion acceptance is not an overall visual-quality victory.
